title: Prove the minimum paid companion for dirty chart transport
head: 55e437a31be0ed4062e2454db2e29aefbad95349
body:
Reviewed PR1858 permits a connector-only chart exactly when the two source maps have equal kernels. This contribution changes the contract with an explicitly paid dirty companion: for B0,B1:X→Z, the minimum auxiliary signal dimension permitting R(B0,D)=(B1,E) is rank[B0;B1]−min(rankB0,rankB1). The proof covers arbitrary fields and finite dimensions, including zero maps; it does not assign chart or storage costs for free.

A complete F2 pilot with different-rank source maps, one actual dirty companion bit and noncommuting readers restores all dirt in56 scalar XORs versus68 for two closed echoes. D/E and both three-XOR swaps are counted. The declared fixed-port tariff is1340 versus1496, excluding separately identified admission/preparation. General chart synthesis, selected caller lifetime, frames/routing/native costs and supplier integration remain unknown.

Validation: all256 ordered binary2x2 map pairs and512 larger fixtures construct actual invertible charts. An independent exhaustive D/E kernel census confirms all256 sharp minima. Literal replay checks all131072 dirty inputs and inverses; an independent17-bit Boolean operator/invoice check and five semantic counterexamples pass. Registered CPython3.12 replay also passes optimized Git-free read-only, source-corruption, typed-receipt and output-overwrite controls. No hosted CI or formal-kernel pass is claimed.

Credit: woklerx/PR1858 supplies the equal-kernel criterion and carried-dirt protocol; Ross Richardson/PR943 supplies the original alphabet and945-pairing baseline, reproduced before this scope. Picker connector-alphabet-change nonce ade63e0baaeccfa15a623b46e110958f. Started from canonical mainb5ea56e0; pre-submission6bd33bc0 leaves instructions and inputs unchanged. Bounded cached overlap plus fresh recent PR checks are recorded. Prepared for ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
